must_catch.reference_explanation: writer is never closed -- if write() throws, or on any other exit path, the underlying file handle leaks.
must_catch.reference_suggested_fix: Use try-with-resources: `try (FileWriter writer = new FileWriter(path)) { writer.write(content); }`.
